treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Armenia and the Government of the State of Israel for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital, and Protocol (2017, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: [IL list] Convention ... Armenia ... with respect to taxes on income and on capital Armenia Original 25-07-2017 N/A || [AM MLI position] ...and on Capital State of Israel Original 25-07-2017 31-12-2018
source_title: MLI matching and synthesised text Armenia-Israel (Armenian MoF)

rates.quote: b) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership or a real estate investment company) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends; [MLI Art. 8(1):] Subparagraph b of paragraph 2 of Article 10 of this Convention shall apply only if the ownership conditions described in those provisions are met throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividends
c) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties, in the case of payments of the kind referred to in sub-paragraphs a) and b) of paragraph 3;

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of the Convention, a benefit under the Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit

notes: Dividends: Art. 10(2)(a) 0% where beneficial owner is the other State, its Central Bank, or a resident pension plan holding not more than 25% of capital/voting power (not modelled). 365-day holding for the 5% tier added by MLI Art. 8(1), effective for WHT from 2024-01-01. Art. 10(3): distributions by an Israeli real estate investment fund to holders of <10% capped at 15% (not dividends per Protocol para 7). Interest: exempt if paid to or by the Government, a local authority or the Central Bank (Art. 11(3)). Royalties: 5% for patents, trade marks, designs, models, plans, secret formulas/know-how and equipment (para 3(a)-(b)) - recorded; 10% for copyright of literary/artistic/scientific works incl. films (Art. 12(2)(b), para 3(c)) - not modelled. MLI Art. 7(1) replaces para 1 of treaty Art. 27 (main-purpose anti-abuse). Art. 29: WHT on amounts paid on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2018-12-31 -> 2019-01-01). Synthesised text: MLI effective for WHT in both States from 1 January 2024.
